detail.title: MK1900 RGB Keyboard with Volume Knob & Alarm Clock
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MK1900 is a full-size mechanical-feel gaming keyboard that goes beyond typing with a built-in digital display, dual multimedia control knobs and a configurable alarm clock. The 93-key layout plus 6 dedicated macro keys, combined with full 26-key anti-ghosting, ensures every input registers cleanly during competitive gaming or fast typing sessions. Dual rotary knobs give instant control over volume and lighting without needing to alt-tab out of a game, while vibrant multi-zone RGB backlighting with DIY effects adds a customizable visual layer to any setup. Rated for 30 million keystrokes and built with a 1.5m braided cable and durable ABS keycaps, it's a genuinely feature-packed keyboard for gamers who want more than the basics, working across Windows, Mac and Linux with USB plug-and-play.
